messages.subject: Re: Run Shiny apps over Server name
parts:
servername.com is definitely resolving to the correct IP? If you're sure, can you try the same thing without the server_name directive? (It's only necessary if you want to serve up different content on the same IP address based on the hostname)

On Wed, Nov 5, 2014 at 7:08 AM, Sam <domalpa...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi Team,

I am running into a weird issue. Can you help me on the following issue.

So, far I was running my shiny apps over ip address over port 3838 (http://10.x.xx.xx:3838/hello). This worked fine, but when I edited code to browse using server name it is not loading the page. (http://servername.com:3838/hello).  What I am doing wrong?

server {

listen 3838;

server_name  servername.com;

location / {

site_dir /var/shiny-server/www;

log_dir /var/shiny-server/log;

directory_index on;

}

}

Thanks,
Suman
